bridge_review.reason: The bridge correctly requires fresh connector bytes, Git blob SHA verification, isolated materialization, and local unittest execution. This verifier runtime can read connector content but has no supported mechanism to transfer the returned exact file bytes into the isolated Python/container filesystem as executable files. Manually reconstructing source from rendered tool output would violate exact-byte verification.

defer_reason: Independent exact-byte test execution remains unavailable in this runtime. Static review plus Builder/Quantum test claims are insufficient for PASS.
release_condition: Expose an executable checkout/file mount of the exact branch blobs to C, or provide a trusted CI/workflow run bound to the exact artifact blob SHAs and branch tree SHA; then C independently reruns/verifies the required 27+ tests and invariants.
